noClustersConfigured: No clusters configured. Add a cluster first.
noScansYet: No scans have been run yet. Click "Scan now" to check for vulnerabilities.
rebootAlwaysHelp: Reboot every node after its upgrade.
rebootAutoHelp: Reboot a node only if its upgrade installs a kernel or, for an automated upgrade, asks for a reboot.
cephWaitHelp: Take a node down, and move its guests back, only once every placement group is active+clean. A wait over 30 minutes pauses the job.
cephOneAtATime: With this on, the nodes are taken one at a time whatever the parallelism.
cephNooutHelp: Keep Ceph from marking a rebooting node's OSDs out and copying their data elsewhere. Cleared when the job ends.
startJobTitle_one: Start the rolling update on {{count}} node?
startJobTitle_other: Start the rolling update on {{count}} nodes?
startJobNodesUnread: Nexara could not read which nodes the job updates.
startJobOrderOne: Nexara updates one node at a time.
startJobOrderMany: Nexara updates {{count}} nodes at a time.
startJobOrderCeph: Nexara updates one node at a time, waiting for Ceph to be clean before each.
startJobCephNoout: Ceph's noout flag is held while the job runs.
startJobEachNodeInPlace: Guests are not moved, and each node is {{steps, list}}.
startJobStepRebootIfKernel: rebooted if its updates include a kernel
startJobStepRebootInPlace: rebooted unless a guest is running
startJobStepRebootRequired: marked Reboot required if it needs a reboot
startJobStepRebootRequiredIfKernel: marked Reboot required if its updates include a kernel
cancelJobPending: The job has not started, so nothing on the cluster changes. A cancelled job cannot be started again: to run it, create it again.
cancelJobActive: No further node is started, and the job cannot be resumed. An upgrade under way finishes without a reboot, and guests already moved stay where they are. Nexara then releases what the job held, such as paused DRS and disabled HA rules.
jobPausedNote: Nothing advances until you resume; an upgrade under way finishes, but its node is not rebooted until then. DRS, rebalancing, HA rules and noout stay as the job left them.

nooutState.already_set: noout set before the job, left alone

sshTestNotRoot: This account is not root. Sensor readings work, but automated upgrades need root and stop at each node before it is drained.
summaryPurpose: Known vulnerabilities on each node, and rolling package updates.
summaryNoScans: No vulnerability scan has run for this cluster yet
